findings.finding: The check adds a payment-card preservation requirement that the source does not impose.
findings.source_support: No request was made about payment or billing settings.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Checking that the saved payment card remains unchanged is an extra verification requirement.

findings.finding: The verification targets C-140 instead of the specified customer C-104.
findings.source_support: For customer C-104, change the contact email to kai@example.test.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: It does not verify the requested email change for C-104; it checks a different customer.

findings.finding: The verification does not check that other customers remain unchanged.
findings.source_support: No other customer may be edited.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: No check excludes edits to other customers.

findings.finding: The reopened status check does not bind the Approved status to document D-41.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: It checks that some document is Approved, leaving the target identity unverified.

findings.finding: An unchanged document count does not establish that every other document is unchanged.
findings.source_support: Every other document must remain unchanged.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The total-count check can pass even if another document's contents changed.

findings.finding: The verification specifies FAIL when the independent source is unavailable, contrary to the required UNKNOWN outcome.
findings.source_support: If that source cannot be reached, return UNKNOWN and do not submit the release.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Unavailable-source behavior must return UNKNOWN, not FAIL.

findings.finding: The verification omits the requirement not to submit the release when the source is unavailable.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: No check or behavior prohibits release submission on source unavailability.

findings.finding: The verification does not check that existing shortcuts remain unchanged.
findings.source_support: No existing shortcut may be changed.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The no-change constraint on existing shortcuts is unchecked.

findings.finding: The source does not identify which of the three highlighted tasks is selected, so the verification's choice of the first task is unsupported by the source.
findings.source_support: there are three highlighted tasks, and the request gives no rule for choosing among them.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The verification assumes the first highlighted task is the target without a source-defined selection rule.

findings.finding: The verification specifies FAIL when the independent source is unavailable, contrary to the required UNKNOWN outcome and prohibition on claiming success or failure.
findings.source_support: return UNKNOWN and do not claim either success or failure.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Unavailable-source behavior must return UNKNOWN, not FAIL.

findings.finding: The compact-view Owner check does not bind the value to record R-22.
findings.source_support: the same record ID R-22 must show both values
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: It checks Owner=Lee on an unspecified record in the compact view.

findings.finding: The checks do not verify that both values appear on R-22 in both views.
findings.source_support: In both compact and detail views, the same record ID R-22 must show both values
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Status is checked only in detail view and Owner only in compact view.

findings.finding: Retaining all record IDs does not establish that every other record is unchanged.
findings.source_support: Every other record must be unchanged.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The ID-presence check does not verify other records' values or contents.

findings.finding: The verification checks the current settings view but omits the required persistence check after closing and reopening.
findings.source_support: After closing and reopening the endpoint settings, E-2 must remain disabled.

findings.finding: The verification omits preserving J-08's assigned Owner.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: No check confirms the Owner remains unchanged.

findings.finding: The verification omits the required audit entry.
findings.source_support: add one audit entry recording the status change.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: No check confirms that one audit entry records the status change.

findings.finding: The source does not identify the shared queue item or define what final means; the verification invents both a target and a state.
findings.source_support: does not define which queue item is shared or what state counts as final.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Selecting the first visible item and setting it to Done are unsupported choices.
